status: post-hoc follow-up analyses added after H8-M; each protocol frozen by SHA-256 before computation

H8-N_decision_agnostic_coherence_baselin.description: Mean inter-channel phase coherence over 28 microphone pairs in the same one-second window; threshold = minimum score of 54 development sessions; applied to the H8-M clean and phase-modified cases.
H8-N_decision_agnostic_coherence_baselin.interpretation: H8-M shows sensitivity to spatial invalidation but does not by itself distinguish AECE from a generic coherence check.

H8-O_decision_localized_vs_off_decision_.description: Phase randomized only in time-frequency bins supporting the classifier decision (A) or in an equal number of other bins (B); magnitude and classifier probability unchanged; 53 sessions.

coherence_check_withheld.threshold: minimum clean validation score (lenient to the baseline)

H8-O_decision_localized_vs_off_decision_.interpretation: AECE responded to invalidation of decision-supporting evidence and not to invalidation of other regions; the B result follows from AECE's design, so H8-O verifies decision conditioning works as designed.

H8-P_runtime.description: Processing time per one-second decision window, 53 sessions, one warm-up excluded, unoptimised research implementation.
H8-P_runtime.cpu: Intel Core i7-10750H (desktop/laptop CPU), Windows 11, Python 3.14, PyTorch 2.14 CPU
H8-P_runtime.interpretation: Not real-time on this CPU; optimisation and edge-device timing are future work.

limitations: Artificial phase-only interventions; not natural-confuser testing.
In H8-L and H8-O the reference hypothesis was held at its clean value; the reference path's response to modified recordings was not tested.
Not field or external validation; not a real-world false-alarm estimate.
AECE is a research module, not yet in the live detection loop.
